summary: Iteration 21: tested vitals trend warnings + doctor per-patient limits, hospital ratings (completion alert, rate/edit, reviews, Bayesian trust sort, admin + account-admin moderation), pharmacy portal products (CSV template/import with row errors, 413/422, add/edit, duplicate SKU 409, Rx compliance), licences (owner-only PATCH), pharmacy application MOH/CR fields. Backend: 23/24 new tests passed; the 1 failure is a pre-existing IDOR in profile_key that the new /api/vitals/trends endpoint also has. Regressions (iter19 + iter20 suites) all pass, 29 passed and 1 skipped, after I updated the old apply payloads to include the newly required moh_license/cr_number. UI passed for: dashboard trends card, rate-visit dialog (create and edit), Find Care rating and reviews dialog, doctor trends with limits editor (save/invalid toast/reset), admin and My Hospital Ratings tabs (hide/show), products page (template download, CSV upload result with import-error rows, add, duplicate toast, edit refresh, Rx required fields), licences card, apply form, Arabic products page, and 390px mobile (products table scrolls inside its card, no page overflow; trends stack). Emails to @sihha.ai fail as 'undeliverable' in the logs and cause no server error.

critical.issue: IDOR: profile_key() returns any profile_id as-is without checking it is the caller or one of their dependents. Patient B read patient A's 7 readings and trend series. POST /api/vitals with another user's profile_id writes vitals into their record and recomputes their trends. Pre-existing helper, but the new trends endpoint exposes health data the same way.

minor.issue: min>=max is only checked when both values are sent. Sending diastolic_max=60 alone (the standard min is 60) gives an effective min == max with no 422.
top_rated uses the rounded rating_avg, so an average of 4.45 rounds to 4.5 and gets the badge. Compare the raw sum/n instead.
The CSV has no 'active' column, so re-uploading a SKU forces active=True. A product the pharmacist had deactivated silently comes back for patients.
Does not check that the account is listed or not suspended. Reviews of unlisted accounts can be read by ID.

ui_bugs.issue: Save sends every prefilled field (the standard 60/90 and 70/126 values). Changing only systolic marks diastolic and glucose as limit_source 'doctor' / 'set by your doctor' too. Send only the values the doctor changed, or leave fields empty unless edited.
Star breakdown shows 1→5 top to bottom: JS orders integer-like object keys ascending. Usually 5 stars goes on top. Sort the entries in descending order.

issues: Copy is written for the patient: 'within your limits', 'your last 2 readings', 'set by your doctor' is shown to the doctor.
A green 'Within limits' badge shows even when there are no readings in 14 days. Show a neutral 'No data' state instead.
Metric labels (Systolic blood pressure / Diastolic / Blood sugar) and the trend messages come from the backend in English and are not translated.
The summary '1 need attention' is only half-translated because the template string is built in JS.
'1 ratings' in the reviews summary should be singular.

action_items: HIGH: validate profile_id in profile_key() (or in the vitals/trends routes). Allow only the caller's user_id or a dependent they own, otherwise return 403/404.
Make VitalLimitsEditor send only the limits the doctor changed, so limit_source stays 'standard' for metrics left untouched.
Compute top_rated from the unrounded average.
Keep the existing active flag on CSV re-import (or add an 'active' column).
Translate trend labels/messages for Arabic (send metric keys and let the frontend translate) and the 'N need attention' string. Reverse the order of the star breakdown.
Use doctor-facing wording in doctor-vital-trends, and show a no-data state on trend cards with no readings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 5,368 lines. New features were again appended to the monolith; consider splitting into routers (vitals_trends, ratings, pharmacy_portal_products).

notify_vital_trends uses next(o for o in CORS_ORIGINS if o.startswith('https://')) with no default. If CORS_ORIGINS has no https origin this raises StopIteration and POST /api/vitals fails with a 500. Use a PUBLIC_APP_URL env var instead.
notify_vital_trends runs a 14-day query and up to 3 Mongo lookups on every POST /api/vitals call. Acceptable for now, but simulate_vitals-style bulk inserts should call it only once (they do).

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all flows work; 2 minor UI bugs, i18n gaps)

Layla's tab is my-hospital-tab-ratings.
rca of the issue: IDOR: profile_key(user, profile_id) at server.py:683 returns profile_id unchanged when it is set. It never checks db.dependents for {dependent_id: profile_id, owner user_id}. Repro: log in as patient B, GET /api/vitals/trends?profile_id=<patient A user_id> returns A's series. Fix: make profile_key async and verify ownership, or add a check helper to every vitals/trends route.
